content.value: Chocked flows are to be created from a large reservoir kept at high pressure. Discuss how these can be created for the following processes:
(i) A duct with varying cross-sectional area. Neglect friction and heat transfer.
(ii)A constant area duct with friction and adiabatic flow.
(iii) A constant area duct with heat transfer but negligible friction.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2024
